overview.stale.other: %[1]d open proposals have waited at least %[2]d hours for an answer.

overview.disputes.other: %[1]d disputes are open or under review.

overview.posting.one: %[1]d dispute is decided but the reversal is not yet posted.
overview.posting.other: %[1]d disputes are decided but the reversal is not yet posted.

overview.limit.one: %[1]d active member is at or beyond their credit limit.
overview.limit.other: %[1]d active members are at or beyond their credit limit.

overview.check_none.other: No ledger check has been recorded yet.

overview.check_failed.other: The last ledger check found problems.

balance.limit_used.other: You are using %[1]s of your %[2]s credit limit.

status.explanation_1.other: Nothing has been posted yet. The amount is held aside from the payer's available credit until it is accepted, declined, cancelled or expires.

status.explanation_3.other: The other party declined. Nothing was posted.

status.explanation_4.other: Withdrawn before it was accepted. Nothing was posted.

status.explanation_5.other: Not answered in time. Nothing was posted.

status.explanation_6.other: A dispute is open. Postings stay as they were until a reviewer decides.

status.explanation_7.other: Fully reversed by a later posting.

financial.row.grant.receive.other: Sign-up grant: You will receive %[2]s %[3]s from %[1]s

footer.credits.other: Credits are accounting units used inside one network. They are a record of who has given and received value; they have no value outside it and are not guaranteed to be accepted.

terms.accept.other: I have read and accept these terms

session.ending.other: Your session is about to end.

dashboard.explain.other: Available to spend is not your balance: pending outgoing trades reduce it.

dashboard.needs_empty.other: Nothing is waiting for you. Proposals sent to you will appear here.

dashboard.recent_empty.other: No completed activity yet. Completed trades will appear here.

dashboard.outgoing_empty.other: You have no pending trades waiting for others.

notice.closing_date.other: This network closes on %[1]s. You can keep trading until then. Download your data before the date; read access continues for a while afterwards.

notice.membership_suspended.other: Your membership is suspended. You can view your trades and history, and decline or withdraw trades, but you cannot propose, accept or post. Contact the network administrator to ask about restoring it.

notice.membership_departed.other: You have left this network. You can still read your history and download your data.

notice.network_closed.other: This network is closed. History stays readable and exports are available; new trades are not possible.

notice.network_closing.other: This network has reached its closing date and is completing its closure. New trades are not possible; history stays readable and exports are available.

notice.admin_required.other: This network has no active administrator, so it is read-only (administrator required). You can read balances and history and download your data; nothing that moves value is possible until an administrator is appointed.

notice.trading_paused.other: Trading in this network is paused (suspended). You can read balances and history and download your data; new trades and acceptances are not possible until it resumes.

auth.throttle.minute.other: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again. Nothing changed.

auth.throttle.few_minutes.other: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again. Nothing changed.

auth.throttle.login.other: Too many attempts for this login. Wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.throttle.login_nothing.other: Too many attempts for this login. Wait a few minutes and try again. Nothing changed.

auth.throttle.account.other: Too many attempts for this account. Wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.not_saved.other: Not saved. Fix the problems below. Nothing changed.

auth.mismatch.confirm.other: Confirm password: the two passwords do not match. Type the same password in both fields.

auth.mismatch.confirm_new.other: Confirm new password: the two passwords do not match. Type the same password in both fields.

auth.login.failed.other: The login or password is not correct. Check both and try again.

auth.login.failed_field.other: Login or password: check both and try again.

auth.flash.registered.other: Thank you. If that login was available the account now exists. Sign in with it and your password.

auth.flash.recovered.other: Your password was changed and you were signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password. Make new recovery codes after you sign in.

auth.flash.password_changed.other: Password changed. You were signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password.

auth.flash.must_change.other: Your password was reset for you. Choose a new password to continue. Your current password is the temporary one you were given.

auth.recover.failed.other: The login or recovery code is not correct, or the code was already used. Check both and try again. Nothing changed.

auth.field.current_password_wrong.other: Current password: not correct. Check it and try again.

auth.field.password_wrong.other: Password: not correct. Check it and try again.

auth.field.code_wrong.other: Code: not correct. Use the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app (or an unused recovery code where allowed). Codes work once.

auth.mfa.invalid_state.other: Not done. Two-step sign-in is not in a state that allows that (for example the setup expired, or it is not turned on). Nothing changed.

auth.mfa.already_on.other: Not done. Two-step sign-in is already turned on. Nothing changed.

auth.mfa.step_failed.other: The code is not correct, or the sign-in timed out. Nothing changed.

auth.mfa.step_failed_field.other: Code: not correct, or the sign-in timed out. Check the code and try again, or sign in again.

security.notice.password_changed.other: Your password was changed and you were signed out everywhere.

security.notice.recovery_regen.other: Your recovery codes were replaced. Older codes no longer work.

security.notice.recovery_used.other: A recovery code was used to sign in.

security.notice.admin_granted.other: A new administrator was appointed in one of your networks.

security.notice.other.other: A security-related change was made to your account.

auth.hint.login_new.other: At least 3 characters, no spaces. An email address works well.

auth.hint.password_rules.other: At least 12 characters. A password manager is fine; pasting is allowed.

auth.hint.signin_code.other: For example 123456, or ABCDE-FGHIJ. Each code works once.

auth.hint.recovery_format.other: Looks like ABCD-EFGH-IJKL-MNOP. Capital letters and dashes are optional.

auth.login.join_info.other: To join a network you need an invitation link from its administrator, or the network's join page.

auth.login.recover_tail.other: with one of your recovery codes.

auth.mfa_step.intro.other: Your password was correct. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one unused recovery code. This step expires in 5 minutes.

auth.recover.intro.other: Lost your password? Enter your login, one of your recovery codes and a new password. Each code works once. If you have no codes left, ask your network administrator to reset your password.

auth.codes.shown_once.other: This is the only time they are shown.

auth.codes.keep_safe.other: Write them down or print them and keep them somewhere safe and separate from your password manager. Each code works once. Any codes you had before no longer work.

auth.codes.purpose.other: Recovery codes let you set a new password if you forget it, without email.

auth.codes.replace_note.other: Making new codes replaces all the old ones. You need your current password.

security.mfa.off_explain.other: Turn it on to protect your account if your password is stolen. Administrators may be required to use it.

security.codes.explain.other: A recovery code lets you set a new password without email if you forget it.

security.codes.link.other: Make or replace password recovery codes

security.notices.advice.other: If you do not recognise a change, change your password and turn on two-step sign-in.

auth.enrol.already_on.other: Two-step sign-in is already on. Manage it on the

auth.enrol.intro.other: Two-step sign-in asks for a code from an authenticator app each time you sign in, in addition to your password.

auth.enrol.need_password.other: For your security, enter your password to start.

auth.enrol.step_key.other: In your authenticator app choose to add an account by entering a key, and type this setup key. Choose time-based, 6 digits, 30 seconds.

auth.enrol.uri_note.other: Apps that import links can use this address instead:

auth.enrol.step_confirm.other: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to confirm.

auth.enrol.expiry.other: This setup key is shown only while setup is in progress and expires after 15 minutes.

auth.save.body.other: They are shown only once and cannot be shown again. Each code works one time if you lose access to your authenticator app. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager or a printed copy.

auth.password.intro.other: Changing your password signs you out on every device. API tokens you created keep working until you revoke them.
